name: Original Cloverbrook garden showcase
source: tools/art/build_park25d_showcase.py (authored integer-coordinate shapes, no reference pixel sampling)
texture_alpha: opaque; all marks wrap periodically across the 32x32 tile
seed_role: 230 selects the stable offset of authored soil/path marks; no random pixel scatter
shading: four foliage tones including contour; three material tones plus outline for trunks; upper-left highlights
validate: uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests/art -p test_park25d_showcase.py
scope: eight textures and eight environment sprites only; GLBs are preserved, not regenerated or certified here
plaster: warm cream with sparse, authored two-tone wear using cream and cream_light
sprite_anchor: bottom center pixel boundary (width/2, height); roots intersect bottom row
sprite_padding: at least one transparent pixel top/left/right, zero bottom padding
character_scope: none; retain existing eight-direction Fae and separate battle sprites
